_comment: BookMyShow white-label monitor config. See bms_monitor.py header for how the codes were discovered and for the SeatsAvailable=capacity trap. To watch a different BMS white-label cinema: open its site, find the cinemas.bookmyshow.com iframe domain, and read companyCode/subregionCode from the page's __NEXT_DATA__ runtimeConfig.websiteConfigurations.
_screen_note: Prasads: SCREEN 6 = PCX (629 seats, the big one). SCREEN 4 = HDR by Barco (390). screen_match is a case-insensitive substring of ScreenName.
_rows_note: PCX Screen 6 rows run A (front, nearest screen) to N (rear). watch_rows are the ones you actually want; a seat opening there fires an urgent push naming the exact seat numbers.
_dates_note: auto = discover every date BMS lists (IBVGETSHOWDATESBYEVENT). A brand-new date on sale fires an urgent push. Hard-coding a single date is what made us miss the Aug 10-16 release.
_topics_note: Alerts publish to ntfy_topic plus any also_topics entries. Kept empty: phone is subscribed to odyssey_prasads_ak2026 (confirmed 2026-08-08). Add a second topic here only as a delivery fallback.
